technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by bearish structure (death cross, price below key EMAs, weak trend), making this a low-probability entry despite volume spike.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 46 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed retail positioning.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar headwind for energy multinationals, and earnings event in 46 days creates binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9/14, StochRSI cross-up, Williams %R rising) with 3x volume spike and CMF cross-up create textbook bounce setup in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish structural breakdown (EMA 9/21 death cross, price below both key EMAs, MACD bearish, weak ADX trend, parabolic SAR bearish, three black crows) combined with crisis-level macro (inverted yield curve, VIX 317, strong dollar headwind) and zero fundamental conviction make this a bear trap bounce, not a reversal.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold bounce signals (RSI 9/14, StochRSI cross-up, 3x volume spike) present technical setup, but bearish structural breakdown (EMA death cross, price below key EMAs, MACD bearish, weak trend) combined with crisis-level macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX 317, strong dollar) creates high probability of bear trap rather than reversal.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 46 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signal and energy sector macro headwinds could trigger sharp downside break below current support, invalidating oversold bounce thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear dominance despite technical oversold signals
decision.portfolio_note: Already 4 positions open in Energy sector; adding MPC increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro deterioration; skip preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
